Designed and deployed end-to-end finance data, GenAI, and agentic AI workflows using Python, SQL, Databricks, and Apache Airflow, enabling accurate, timely, and automated regulatory and management reporting across Alphabet-aligned platforms.
Developed and optimized enterprise-grade financial data models (conceptual, logical, physical) aligned with taxonomy and business rules, enhancing reuse for analytics,
LLM-powered insights, RAG-based retrieval, and AI-driven decision support across Power BI and Looker Studio dashboards.

Built scalable ETL, ML, and GenAI pipelines integrated with GA4, ERP systems, and Google Sheets, ensuring traceability, lineage, and governance for sensitive financial datasets in compliance with audit and regulatory standards.
Enhanced dashboard performance and real-time financial decision-making by embedding LLM- and RAG-driven insights,
integrating GA4 feeds, and refactoring semantic models, leading to measurable improvements in reporting accuracy and latency.

Implemented advanced governance, security, and audit controls (GDPR-compliant access, metadata tagging, lineage tracking) to ensure responsible deployment of GenAI and agentic AI solutions across finance data workflows.

Automated data quality and validation using PySpark and NLP/LLM-driven anomaly detection, reducing manual reporting errors by 40% and enabling agentic AI systems to support risk, compliance, and financial integrity checks.
Led adoption of CI/CD and MLOps practices (Git, Airflow, MLflow) for ML, GenAI, and agentic AI pipelines, streamlining deployment, ensuring reproducibility, and enabling seamless
integration with cloud-based ERP and financial
data platforms.
Data Scientist IT Solutions
CSS Corp Private, Chennai, India

Applied statistical modeling, ML, GenAI, and LLM-based analysis in Python and Excel to uncover payment trends, denial drivers, and reimbursement bottlenecks, generating actionable insights that improved RCM operations and revenue optimization.

Designed and automated RCM performance dashboards using SQL, Python, and advanced Excel, integrating LLM-driven anomaly detection and agentic AI workflows to monitor claims processing, collections, and denial rates in near real time.

Queried and engineered claims and billing datasets with advanced SQL and Python, building predictive and classification models (logistic regression, decision trees) augmented with RAG-based LLM pipelines to proactively flag high-risk claims for pre-submission review and automated intervention prioritization.
Developed structured ETL, ML, and GenAI-ready
pipelines integrating payer, clinical, and financial datasets, enabling early-stage predictive modeling of claim acceptance likelihood and downstream payment outcomes.

Authored transparent technical documentation for ML, GenAI, and agentic AI workflows, covering model assumptions, prompt strategies, and denial resolution processes, ensuring compliance, audit readiness, and explainability across RCM teams.

Implemented NLP- and LLM-driven denial analysis (keyword extraction, semantic grouping, GenAI summarization) combined with agentic AI routing logic, improving first-pass acceptance rates by 20% and reducing manual review time.

Standardized RCM metrics and financial data models across revenue cycle functions, enabling ML-driven claim scoring, RAG-enhanced evidence retrieval, A/B testing of collection strategies, and GenAI-powered KPI monitoring in collaboration with finance, compliance, and IT teams.
Mentored junior analysts and data scientists on
applying ML, GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI to healthcare claims, while leading sprint-based delivery of RCM analytics initiatives aligned with best practices in AI engineering and enterprise
data science.
Business Analyst
Zoondia Software Solutions, Trivandrum, India
Built and maintained strong client relationships, increasing customer satisfaction and contributing to sustained business growth through solution- oriented engagement.
Collaborated with customers and strategic partners, expanding the business network by 30% and securing 5 high-value partnerships within a single quarter.
Developed customized client solutions informed by business needs and performance data, driving measurable outcomes aligned with stakeholder goals.
Negotiated contracts and service-level agreements, ensuring both revenue continuity and client success through data-backed justifications.
Created clear and structured documentation and training materials, supporting smooth onboarding, internal knowledge transfer, and process standardization.
Actively engaged in cross-functional team discussions, translating client feedback into actionable insights for product, analytics, and operations teams.
Championed a collaborative problem-solving approach, using stakeholder input and service analytics to resolve operational bottlenecks and improve client experiences.
